properties.name: /jot: one skill reached by /jot, /note and /log-issue; follow-ups carry their tag and where they settle
properties.rationale: req:a-jot-captures-an-idea-in-one-breath-and-sorts-it-later, accepted on Anthony's word 2026-09-24 ("Let's build /jot in reflow2"), settled as dec:log-issue-folds-into-jot. The word carries the kind so nothing is asked at capture; one list so there is no second pile; the tag on fact_type so every follow-up captured before today still reads, as untagged, and no schema change is needed. Built from the dev_reflow2 hub session on branch feat/jot, after the flo2 brainstorm dec:idea-jot-it-down-now-work-it-through-later (his brother's habit of dumping shop ideas into flo2 was the evidence). The core test file failed to compile against the unchanged code before the change was written.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: New served skill `jot` replaces `log-issue`. COMMAND_ALIASES gains note→jot and log-issue→jot, and ANSWERS_TO_ITS_OWN_NAME keeps jot's shortcut /jot. Commands jot.md and note.md are new, and log-issue.md now names the jot skill and the ISSUE tag. FollowUp gains `tag` (from fact_type follow_up:<tag>) and `settle_toward`; open_follow_ups reads follow_up and follow_up:<tag>; loop_status's next line counts open notes by tag. capture-session's boundary paragraph points at the tags. loop_status's tool description names /jot.
